notes.en: A saved Wi-Fi network that is not there is given up on once two scans have not found it, about 5 s (4.9 s measured) instead of 15 s per attempt, so a wake-up whose usual network has gone is much shorter. Released with server 1.4.0, but works with 1.3.0 as well.
notes.zh-TW: 已儲存的 Wi-Fi 不在範圍內時，連續兩次掃描都找不到就放棄，約 5 秒（實測 4.9 秒），原本每次嘗試要 15 秒，平常的網路不見時喚醒時間大幅縮短。與伺服器 1.4.0 一起發布，搭配 1.3.0 也能使用。

notes.en: Choosing a saved Wi-Fi network again, in the installer or on the setup page, makes it the one tried first; a new password replaces the old entry instead of adding another. When the usual network is gone, the frame scans and tries only the saved networks in range (55 s instead of 152 s measured). No server change.
notes.zh-TW: 在安裝器或設定頁重新選擇已儲存的 Wi-Fi，會改成優先連線；換了密碼會取代舊項目，不再多存一筆。平常的網路不在時，相框會先掃描，只試範圍內的已存網路（實測由 152 秒縮短為 55 秒）。伺服器沒有變動。

notes.en: Finds the server on the network without a typed address. Wi-Fi can be set from the web installer; a network that does not connect is reported rather than saved, and the setup page now says so too and stays open for another try. The panel refresh is waited out in light sleep with Wi-Fi off, and timer wake-ups skip the button check: about half the battery use.
notes.zh-TW: 自動在網路上找到伺服器，不必輸入網址。可以在網頁安裝器設定 Wi-Fi；連不上的網路會回報失敗而不會被儲存，設定頁現在也會顯示失敗並保持開啟讓你重試。面板刷新期間關閉 Wi-Fi 並進入淺層睡眠，定時喚醒略過按鈕檢查：耗電約減半。

notes.en: Improv Serial identification: the web installer recognises the frame and updates it without erasing the settings.
notes.zh-TW: 支援 Improv Serial 識別：網頁安裝器可認出相框，升級時不清除設定。

notes.en: Status screens on the panel (setup with QR codes, errors, low battery), quiet retries with back-off instead of restart loops, faster wake-ups, wake-up telemetry in the server log.
notes.zh-TW: 面板狀態畫面（含 QR code 的設定畫面、錯誤、低電量）、失敗後退避重試取代重啟迴圈、更快的喚醒、伺服器記錄中的喚醒遙測。
